kinds.name: invoice
kinds.description: a request to pay for goods or services, including bills for water, gas, electricity and phone.

kinds.name: receipt
kinds.description: proof that something was paid, including bank transfers and tax payments.

kinds.name: bank_statement
kinds.description: a list of movements on an account.

kinds.name: identity_document
kinds.description: an ID card, passport, licence or permit.

kinds.name: ticket
kinds.description: a ticket for travel or an event.

fields.issuer: the company, office or person that issued the document.
fields.number: the document's own identifier (invoice, receipt or policy number).
fields.issued_on: the date the document was issued.
fields.total_amount: the total to pay, or the total paid.
fields.service: the utility it is for (water, gas, electricity, phone, internet).
fields.bill_type: the type of bill, as the document states it.
fields.consumption_smc: the gas consumed in the billed period, in Smc.
fields.consumption_kwh: the electricity consumed in the billed period, in kWh.
fields.consumption_mc: the water consumed in the billed period, in mc.
fields.recipient: the person or company the document is addressed to.
fields.concerns: the person the document is about, when it is not the recipient (the student of a course, the patient of a visit).
fields.customer_code: the recipient's customer number with the issuer.
fields.contract_code: the number of the contract the document belongs to.
fields.payment_method: how it is or was paid (direct debit, bank transfer, cash, card).
fields.iban: the bank account it is paid from or to.
fields.instalment_2_date: the second instalment's due date; further ones numbered the same way, in date order.
fields.instalment_2_amount: the second instalment's amount; further ones numbered the same way.
fields.annual_consumption: the consumption over the last year, when stated.
fields.annual_spend: the spending over the last year, when stated.
fields.supply_address: the address where the service is supplied, when it differs from the recipient's.
fields.supply_point_code: the code of the supply point (POD for electricity, PDR for gas).
fields.offer_name: the name of the offer, tariff or plan.
fields.offer_ends_on: the date the offer's price conditions end.
fields.distributor: the company that runs the network (distributore).
fields.emergency_phone: the number for faults and emergencies (pronto intervento).
fields.direct_debit_mandate: the code of the direct debit mandate (SDD).
fields.previous_bills_paid: whether the document says earlier bills are paid (yes or no).
fields.billing_frequency: how often bills are issued (monthly, bimonthly...).
fields.next_bill_on: the date the next bill will be issued.
